latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release: Adds skill to speak assistant’s responses aloud on macOS using the built-in say command when user input comes from voice recognition.
- Triggers only if user message starts with "User talked via voice recognition".
- Checks each message individually; context is not retained between messages.
- Acknowledges requests before performing time-consuming actions, ensuring users know they were heard.
- Uses on-device macOS TTS (`say`), never cloud TTS.
- Falls back to text-only response and notifies user if `say` fails.
